faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application via email for the Junior Research Fellow post is 13 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position in the National Institute of Technology Calicut recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. in Chemistry with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade and a valid NET/GATE Certificate to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Junior Research Fellow at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, along with 16% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Calicut primarily involves an Offline Interview, tentatively scheduled for 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Junior Research Fellow be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will be posted in Calicut, Kerala, at the National Institute of Technology Calicut.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants should attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs along with their bio-data.
